The Hostage Princess'' |author=[[Ryder Windham]] |cover artist= |illustrator= |editor= |publisher=[[Scholastic]] |early release= |release date=[[December]] [[2002]]''Star Wars Adventures 3: The Hostage Princess'' was released in a bundle with [[Star Wars Adventures Magazine 3|''Star Wars Adventure Magazine'' 3]], which was released in [[December]] [[2002]] |intl release= |rereleased= |media type=Paperback |pages=90 |isbn=0439458811 |isbn2= |isbn3= |audiobook=N/A |timeline=[[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]]{{CSWECite|I|151|Cradossk}} dates the events of the [[Star Wars Adventures (Scholastic)|''Star Wars Adventures'']] series to a year before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. |series=[[Star Wars Adventures (Scholastic)|''Star Wars Adventures'' (Scholastic)]] |preceded by=[[Star Wars Adventures 2: The Cavern of Screaming Skulls|''The Cavern of Screaming Skulls'']] |followed by=[[Star Wars Adventures 4: Jango Fett vs. the Razor Eaters|''Jango Fett vs. the Razor Eaters'']] }} '''''Star Wars Adventures 3: The Hostage Princess''''' was the third installment of [[Scholastic]]'s [[Star Wars Adventures (Scholastic)|''Star Wars Adventures'']] series. It consisted of a young reader novel and an accompanying game book for use with the story, and was sent out with [[Star Wars Adventures Magazine 3|''Star Wars Adventures Magazine'' 3]] in [[December]] [[2002]].
